column1: # Words that offer an emoji while typing: keyword, emoji (best first, at most five), kind.
# Kinds: word keeps the word and adds the emoji after it; sound (haha, huhu) and emoticon (:))
# are replaced by the emoji. Country names come from CLDR in misc/gen-emoji-keywords.py.
# The list is picked by hand: CLDR keywords alone include words such as `có` and `không`.
# Short names CLDR leaves out; not "Anh" or "Trung", which start sentences and names.
